description: Project Intelligence — Live GitHub Sync & Case-Study Drawer

userStories.title: Project Schema Extensions for GitHub Stats and Case Studies
userStories.description: As a developer, I need ProjectSchema in lib/profile-schema.ts extended with backwards-compatible optional fields for GitHub metadata and case-study details so that all existing profiles continue to parse safely.
acceptanceCriteria: Extend ProjectSchema with optional githubUrl, githubStats, and caseStudy schemas with safe defaults
Export ProjectCaseStudy and ProjectGithubStats TypeScript types
createEmptyProfile and all existing profile fixture tests continue to parse without errors
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Added ProjectGithubStatsSchema and ProjectCaseStudySchema with backwards-compatible optional fields to ProjectSchema.

userStories.title: In-Memory GitHub Repository Stats Service & API Route
userStories.description: As a user or viewer, I want the portfolio to fetch repository metrics from GitHub via a server-side cached endpoint so that rate limits are respected and GitHub tokens are not exposed to the client.
acceptanceCriteria: Create lib/github/cache.ts providing an in-memory TTL cache with URL normalization for github.com/:owner/:repo
Create API route GET /api/portfolio/github-stats?repo=owner/repo returning stars, forks, language, updatedAt, or cached snapshot
Provide graceful fallback when GitHub API is rate-limited, offline, or returns 404
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Implemented lib/github/cache.ts with in-memory TTL caching and rate-limit fallbacks, app/api/portfolio/github-stats/route.ts, and test suite.

userStories.title: GitHub Live Metrics Badges on Project Cards
userStories.description: As a portfolio visitor, I want to see GitHub stars, primary language, and update freshness on project cards so that I can quickly gauge project activity.
acceptanceCriteria: Render compact GitHub badge bar on project cards in both core-portfolio.tsx and portfolio-renderer.tsx when repo info is available
Badges display star count with star icon, forks count, primary language with color dot, and freshness label
Badges adapt to active theme palette and link securely to GitHub repository
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Built components/github-stats-badge.tsx and integrated across core-portfolio.tsx and portfolio-renderer.tsx.

userStories.title: Interactive Case-Study Slide-Over Drawer Component
userStories.description: As a recruiter or hiring manager, I want to click View Case Study or the project card to open an interactive slide-over drawer detailing problem, architecture, takeaways, and metrics.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement components/case-study-drawer.tsx with slide-over animation, keyboard Escape to close, and backdrop blur
Drawer displays project title, tools badges, problem statement, solution & architecture overview, key takeaways bullet list, and metrics highlight
Include action buttons: Visit Live Demo and View Source Code
Accessible ARIA attributes (role=dialog, aria-modal=true)
Seamless integration into core-portfolio.tsx and portfolio-renderer.tsx
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Built components/case-study-drawer.tsx with CaseStudyProvider and integrated trigger button in core-portfolio.tsx and portfolio-renderer.tsx.

userStories.title: Builder Project Intelligence Controls in Step 4
userStories.description: As a creator using the Folio Builder, I want to edit case-study sections and toggle GitHub live sync for each project so that I can present rich technical stories.
acceptanceCriteria: In components/builder.tsx Step 4 (Projects & practice), add an expandable Technical Case Study & GitHub Sync panel for each project
Inputs for githubUrl, problem, solution, architecture, metrics, and multi-item takeaways
Instant preview button to open and review the Case-Study Drawer directly within the builder interface
Changes persist to the active draft and local storage immediately
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Added expandable Technical Case Study & GitHub Sync accordion in Step 4 of components/builder.tsx with live preview modal and takeaways manager.

userStories.title: Comprehensive Automated Test Suite & Build Verification
userStories.description: As an engineer, I need automated tests verifying schema parsing, cache eviction/freshness, API error handling, and component rendering so that regressions are prevented.
acceptanceCriteria: Unit tests for ProjectSchema and ProjectCaseStudySchema parsing and backward compatibility in tests/projects/case-study.test.ts
Unit tests for GitHub cache normalization, rate-limit fallback, and API endpoint behavior in tests/github/github-sync.test.ts
All test suites pass completely
TypeScript typecheck passes with 0 errors
Production build passes cleanly
userStories.notes: Added tests/projects/case-study.test.ts and tests/github/github-sync.test.ts; all 190 tests pass, typecheck passes with 0 errors, and next build succeeds.
